month_successor.description: Name the month that comes k months after a given month (calendar month arithmetic). Control: integer successor with the same sentence frame.

weekday_successor.description: Day-of-week arithmetic: which weekday is k days after a given weekday. Control: letter-of-alphabet successor in the same frame.

roman_numeral.description: Convert an integer to Roman numerals. Control: convert a Roman numeral written in words-free frame back to Arabic digits (same frame, digit output).

antonym.description: Produce the antonym of an English adjective. Control: copy the same adjective in the same frame.

chinese_numeral.description: Write a digit 1-10 as a Chinese numeral character. Control: copy the Arabic digit in the same frame.

a_an_article.description: Choose the indefinite article 'a' vs 'an' for a noun (vowel-sound rule), in a pattern-completion format. Control: same pattern but copying the noun.

subject_verb_agreement.description: Choose 'is' vs 'are' to agree with a singular/plural subject across an attractor prepositional phrase. Control: same sentences ending with a modal, answer ' be'.

en_fr_translation.description: Translate a common English noun to French in a few-shot list. Control: same list format but English->English (copy).
